mapper.sql: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fact_type = 'FOLLOWUP' THEN customer_id END) AS contactCustomerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fact_type = 'FOLLOWUP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS contactEventCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fact_type = 'PAYMENT' THEN parent_id END) AS paidOrderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fact_type = 'APPOINTMENT_CONFIRMED' THEN parent_id END) AS confirmedAppointmentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fact_type = 'CHECKED_IN' THEN customer_id END) AS checkedInCustomerCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fact_type = 'CHECKED_IN' THEN parent_id END) AS checkedInAppointmentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fact_type = 'SERVICE_DONE' THEN parent_id END) AS serviceCompletedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fact_type = 'REDEMPTION' THEN parent_id END) AS redemptionBatchCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fact_type = 'REDEMPTION' THEN customer_id END) AS redeemedCustomerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fact_type = 'REDEMPTION' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END),0) AS redeemedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fact_type = 'REFUND' THEN parent_id END) AS refundCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fact_type = 'PAYMENT' THEN amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS paidFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fact_type = 'PAYMENT' AND receiver_type = 'PLATFORM' THEN amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS platformPaidFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fact_type = 'PAYMENT' AND receiver_type = 'INSTITUTION' THEN amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS institutionPaidFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fact_type = 'REFUND' THEN amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS refundFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fact_type = 'REFUND' AND receiver_type = 'PLATFORM' THEN amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS platformRefundFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fact_type = 'REFUND' AND receiver_type = 'INSTITUTION' THEN amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS institutionRefundFen, MAX(event_at) AS sourceWatermark
mapper.select: WITH operations_facts AS () SELECT FROM operations_facts

WITH operations_facts AS () SELECT fact_type AS factType, source_id AS sourceId, order_id AS orderId, customer_id AS customerId, campaign_id AS campaignId, campaign_batch_id AS campaignBatchId, sku_id AS skuId, event_at AS eventAt, amount_fen AS amountFen, quantity, source_system AS sourceSystem, receiver_type AS receiverType FROM operations_facts WHERE fact_type = #{factType} ORDER BY event_at DESC, source_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: SELECT f.*, COALESCE(sf.owner_staff_id, sa.owner_staff_id, sr.owner_staff_id, so.owner_at_sale_id) AS staff_id, COALESCE(sa.institution_id, sr.institution_id) AS institution_id FROM operations_facts f LEFT JOIN crm_followup sf ON sf.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND sf.id = f.source_id AND f.fact_type = 'FOLLOWUP' LEFT JOIN crm_appointment_history sh ON sh.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND sh.id = f.source_id AND f.fact_type IN ('APPOINTMENT_CONFIRMED','CHECKED_IN','SERVICE_DONE') LEFT JOIN crm_appointment sa ON sa.tenant_id = sh.tenant_id AND sa.id = sh.appointment_id LEFT JOIN crm_redemption_line srl ON srl.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND srl.id = f.source_id AND f.fact_type = 'REDEMPTION' LEFT JOIN crm_redemption sr ON sr.tenant_id = srl.tenant_id AND sr.id = srl.redemption_id LEFT JOIN crm_order so ON so.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND so.id = f.order_id AND f.fact_type IN ('PAYMENT','REFUND')

COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'FOLLOWUP' THEN e.customer_id END) AS contactCustomerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'FOLLOWUP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS contactEventCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'PAYMENT' THEN e.parent_id END) AS paidOrderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'APPOINTMENT_CONFIRMED' THEN e.parent_id END) AS confirmedAppointmentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'SERVICE_DONE' THEN e.parent_id END) AS serviceCompletedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'CHECKED_IN' THEN e.customer_id END) AS checkedInCustomerCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'CHECKED_IN' THEN e.parent_id END) AS checkedInAppointmentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'REDEMPTION' THEN e.parent_id END) AS redemptionBatchCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'REDEMPTION' THEN e.customer_id END) AS redeemedCustomerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'REDEMPTION' THEN e.quantity ELSE 0 END),0) AS redeemedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'PAYMENT' THEN e.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS paidFen

COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'APPOINTMENT_CONFIRMED' THEN e.parent_id END) AS confirmedAppointmentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'SERVICE_DONE' THEN e.parent_id END) AS serviceCompletedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'CHECKED_IN' THEN e.customer_id END) AS checkedInCustomerCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'CHECKED_IN' THEN e.parent_id END) AS checkedInAppointmentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'REDEMPTION' THEN e.parent_id END) AS redemptionBatchCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'REDEMPTION' THEN e.customer_id END) AS redeemedCustomerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.fact_type = 'REDEMPTION' THEN e.quantity ELSE 0 END),0) AS redeemedCount
mapper.select:
WITH operations_facts AS (), enriched AS () SELECT e.staff_id AS staffUserId, MAX(u.display_name) AS staffName,
FROM enriched e LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND u.id = e.staff_id WHERE e.staff_id IS NOT NULL AND e.staff_id = #{query.criteria.staffUserId} AND e.staff_id = #{query.scope.selfId} GROUP BY e.staff_id ORDER BY e.staff_id

WITH operations_facts AS (), enriched AS () SELECT e.institution_id AS institutionId, COALESCE(MAX(i.short_name), MAX(i.full_name)) AS institutionName, , SUM(outstanding.pending_fen) AS pendingReconciliationFen FROM enriched e LEFT JOIN crm_institution i ON i.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND i.id = e.institution_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sl.tenant_id, sl.redemption_id, SUM(CASE WHEN sb.amount_status = 'VERIFIED' THEN sb.net_payable_fen - sb.paid_fen ELSE NULL END) AS pending_fen FROM crm_settlement_line sl INNER JOIN crm_settlement_batch sb ON sb.tenant_id = sl.tenant_id AND sb.id = sl.settlement_batch_id WHERE sl.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} GROUP BY sl.tenant_id, sl.redemption_id ) outstanding ON outstanding.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND outstanding.redemption_id = e.parent_id AND e.fact_type = 'REDEMPTION' WHERE e.institution_id IS NOT NULL AND e.institution_id = #{query.criteria.institutionId} AND e.staff_id = #{query.criteria.staffUserId} AND e.staff_id = #{query.scope.selfId} GROUP BY e.institution_id ORDER BY e.institution_id

mapper.sql: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'PAYMENT' THEN f.parent_id END) AS paidOrderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'REFUND' THEN f.parent_id END) AS refundCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'PAYMENT' THEN f.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS paidFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'PAYMENT' AND f.receiver_type = 'PLATFORM' THEN f.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS platformPaidFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'PAYMENT' AND f.receiver_type = 'INSTITUTION' THEN f.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS institutionPaidFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'REFUND' THEN f.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS refundFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'REFUND' AND f.receiver_type = 'PLATFORM' THEN f.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS platformRefundFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'REFUND' AND f.receiver_type = 'INSTITUTION' THEN f.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS institutionRefundFen, MAX(f.event_at) AS sourceWatermark

WITH performance_facts AS () SELECT f.attribution_user_id AS userId, MAX(u.display_name) AS displayName,
FROM performance_facts f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND u.id = f.attribution_user_id GROUP BY f.attribution_user_id

WITH performance_facts AS () SELECT fact_type AS factType, source_id AS sourceId, order_id AS orderId, customer_id AS customerId, campaign_id AS campaignId, campaign_batch_id AS campaignBatchId, sku_id AS skuId, event_at AS eventAt, amount_fen AS amountFen, quantity, source_system AS sourceSystem, receiver_type AS receiverType FROM performance_facts WHERE fact_type = #{factType} ORDER BY event_at DESC, source_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
WITH performance_facts AS () SELECT fact_type AS factType, parent_id AS parentId, event_at AS eventAt, amount_fen AS amountFen FROM performance_facts
mapper.sql: INNER JOIN crm_order_item oi ON oi.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND oi.id = e.order_item_id INNER JOIN crm_order o ON o.tenant_id = oi.tenant_id AND o.id = oi.order_id AND o.status IN ('PAID','PARTIALLY_REDEEMED','FULFILLED')

COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'PAYMENT' THEN f.parent_id END) AS paidOrderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'REFUND' THEN f.parent_id END) AS refundCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'APPOINTMENT_CONFIRMED' THEN f.parent_id END) AS confirmedAppointmentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'CHECKED_IN' THEN f.customer_id END) AS checkedInCustomerCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'CHECKED_IN' THEN f.parent_id END) AS checkedInAppointmentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'REDEMPTION' THEN f.parent_id END) AS redemptionBatchCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'REDEMPTION' THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END),0) AS redeemedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'PAYMENT' THEN f.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS paidFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'PAYMENT' AND f.receiver_type = 'PLATFORM' THEN f.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS platformPaidFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'PAYMENT' AND f.receiver_type = 'INSTITUTION' THEN f.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS institutionPaidFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'REFUND' THEN f.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS refundFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'REFUND' AND f.receiver_type = 'PLATFORM' THEN f.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS platformRefundFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fact_type = 'REFUND' AND f.receiver_type = 'INSTITUTION' THEN f.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS institutionRefundFen, MAX(f.event_at) AS sourceWatermark
mapper.select:
WITH campaign_facts AS () SELECT f.campaign_id AS campaignId, f.campaign_batch_id AS campaignBatchId, COALESCE(MAX(f.campaign_code), MAX(ca.campaign_code)) AS campaignCode, COALESCE(MAX(f.batch_code), MAX(cb.batch_code)) AS campaignBatchCode, COALESCE(MAX(f.campaign_name), MAX(ca.campaign_name)) AS campaignName, COALESCE(MAX(f.batch_name), MAX(cb.batch_name)) AS campaignBatchName,
FROM campaign_facts f LEFT JOIN crm_campaign ca ON ca.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND ca.id = f.campaign_id LEFT JOIN crm_campaign_batch cb ON cb.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND cb.id = f.campaign_batch_id AND cb.campaign_id = f.campaign_id WHERE f.campaign_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.campaign_id, f.campaign_batch_id

WITH campaign_facts AS () SELECT NULL AS campaignId, NULL AS campaignBatchId, NULL AS campaignCode, NULL AS campaignBatchCode, NULL AS campaignName, NULL AS campaignBatchName, FROM campaign_facts f WHERE f.campaign_id IS NOT NULL

WITH campaign_facts AS () SELECT fact_type AS factType, source_id AS sourceId, order_id AS orderId, customer_id AS customerId, campaign_id AS campaignId, campaign_batch_id AS campaignBatchId, NULL AS skuId, event_at AS eventAt, amount_fen AS amountFen, quantity, source_system AS sourceSystem, receiver_type AS receiverType FROM campaign_facts f WHERE f.campaign_id IS NOT NULL AND f.fact_type = #{factType} ORDER BY event_at DESC, source_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: SELECT oi.tenant_id, oi.sku_id, oi.id AS order_item_id, o.id AS order_id, o.customer_id, o.campaign_id, o.campaign_batch_id, o.paid_at AS event_at, oi.purchase_quantity AS quantity, o.source_system, o.receiver_type FROM crm_order_item oi INNER JOIN crm_order o ON o.tenant_id = oi.tenant_id AND o.id = oi.order_id AND o.status IN ('PAID','PARTIALLY_REDEEMED','FULFILLED') AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND c.id = o.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE oi.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND o.paid_at >= #{query.window.fromUtc} AND o.paid_at < #{query.window.toUtcExclusive} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_payment_txn actual_payment WHERE actual_payment.tenant_id = oi.tenant_id AND actual_payment.order_id = o.id AND actual_payment.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND actual_payment.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_sku_institution filter_si INNER JOIN crm_institution filter_i ON filter_i.tenant_id = filter_si.tenant_id AND filter_i.id = filter_si.institution_id AND filter_i.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE filter_si.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND filter_si.sku_id = s.id AND filter_si.institution_id = #{query.criteria.institutionId} AND filter_si.status = 'ACTIVE')

WITH sku_sales AS (), sales_by_sku AS ( SELECT sku_id, SUM(quantity) AS sales_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS paid_order_count, COUNT(*) AS paid_line_count, MAX(event_at) AS last_sold_at FROM sku_sales GROUP BY sku_id ) SELECT s.id AS skuId, s.sku_code AS skuCode, s.package_version_id AS packageVersionId, p.package_name AS packageName, s.spec_name AS specName, s.sale_price_fen AS salePriceFen, s.status AS skuStatus, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_sku_institution si INNER JOIN crm_institution i ON i.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND i.id = si.institution_id AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE si.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND si.sku_id = s.id AND si.status = 'ACTIVE') AS activeInstitutionCount, COALESCE(ss.sales_quantity,0) AS salesQuantity, COALESCE(ss.paid_order_count,0) AS paidOrderCount, COALESCE(ss.paid_line_count,0) AS paidLineCount, ss.last_sold_at AS lastSoldAt FROM crm_sku s LEFT JOIN crm_package_version pv ON pv.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND pv.id = s.package_version_id LEFT JOIN crm_package p ON p.tenant_id = pv.tenant_id AND p.id = pv.package_id LEFT JOIN sales_by_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = s.id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND s.id = #{query.criteria.skuId}
ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{query.offset}

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_sku_institution sales_si INNER JOIN crm_institution sales_i ON sales_i.tenant_id = sales_si.tenant_id AND sales_i.id = sales_si.institution_id AND sales_i.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE sales_si.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND sales_si.sku_id = sku_sales.sku_id AND sales_si.institution_id = #{query.criteria.institutionId} AND sales_si.status = 'ACTIVE')

mapper.select: WITH sku_sales AS () SELECT MAX(event_at) FROM sku_sales WHERE 1 = 1

WITH sku_sales AS () SELECT 'PAID_ORDER_LINE' AS factType, order_item_id AS sourceId, order_id AS orderId, customer_id AS customerId, campaign_id AS campaignId, campaign_batch_id AS campaignBatchId, sku_id AS skuId, event_at AS eventAt, NULL AS amountFen, quantity, source_system AS sourceSystem, receiver_type AS receiverType FROM sku_sales WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY event_at DESC, order_item_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
